title: Chapter 17
text: ABOUT THE AUTHOR Tom Mustill is a biologist turned filmmaker and writer, specializing in stories where people and nature meet. His film collaborations, many with Greta Thunberg and David Attenborough, have won dozens of international awards, including two Webbys, a BAFTA, and an Emmy nomination. They’ve been played at the UN and COP26, gone viral, and been shared by heads of state, the World Health Organization, and Guns ’N Roses. He lives in London with his wife, Annie, daughter, Stella, and the inhabitants of their small but surprisingly deep pond. www.grippingfilms.com Instagram @tommustill Twitter @tommustill
